_comment: Template for the real, gitignored configs, one per Apps Script project:
Copy this file to each of those names and fill in scriptId.
Select one with clasp's -P flag, e.g. `clasp status -P .clasp-sync.json`.
(Apps Script editor -> Project Settings -> Script ID).
srcDir    the directory clasp pushes FROM, relative to this file. clasp v3
refuses a srcDir that escapes the config's own directory, which is
why pushes come from a staged dist/ rather than from sheets/*.gs
in place. Each project needs its own appsscript.json inside it.
These files are gitignored: a scriptId identifies a real project of yours.
